evidence: Adds the analyzedescriptor wallet RPC, wallet descriptor analyzer, and scriptpubkeyman integration in src/wallet/.
rationale: Provides verification for multisig setups to ensure cosigners cannot be duped into reduced-threshold or invalid spending policies. Before this change, Core provided no mechanism to check that imported multisig descriptors satisfied agreed k-of-n invariants or were free from duplicate or child xpub cosigner slots.
